nodes.label: Lambda handle()
nodes.desc: Picks a processor via getProcessor, creates a Request, calls app.fetch, then serializes the Result

nodes.label: EventProcessor
nodes.desc: Subclasses for API Gateway v2/v1, ALB and Lambda@Edge translate events and responses

nodes.label: Deno helpers
nodes.desc: serveStatic, toSSG, upgradeWebSocket, getConnInfo (migrating to @hono/deno in v5)

nodes.label: Vercel handle()
nodes.desc: Deprecated one-liner returning app.fetch(req)

nodes.label: Hono class
nodes.desc: Extends HonoBase and installs SmartRouter(RegExpRouter, TrieRouter) as the default router

nodes.label: HonoBase
nodes.desc: Runtime plumbing: route registration, fetch, request(), fire(), default error/not-found handlers

nodes.label: #addRoute
nodes.desc: Merges basePath, wraps handler with RouterRoute metadata and pushes into router.add

nodes.label: app.fetch
nodes.desc: Entry point every runtime calls; forwards method and args to #dispatch

nodes.label: #dispatch
nodes.desc: getPath, router.match, new Context, then fast path or compose

nodes.label: HEAD rewrite
nodes.desc: HEAD requests re-dispatch as GET and strip the body via a null-body Response

nodes.label: Single-handler path
nodes.desc: When the match has exactly one handler, compose() is skipped entirely

nodes.label: Error / 404 handlers
nodes.desc: Default errorHandler and notFoundHandler, replaceable via onError()/notFound()

nodes.label: getPath
nodes.desc: Path extraction, strict mode via getPathNoStrict, mergePath, checkOptionalParameter

nodes.label: hono/tiny preset
nodes.desc: HonoBase subclass wired to PatternRouter for minimal bundle size

nodes.label: PatternRouter
nodes.desc: Linear-loop matcher used by the tiny preset

nodes.label: Router interface
nodes.desc: add/match contract, Result<T> shape, METHOD_NAME_ALL, UnsupportedPathError

nodes.label: SmartRouter
nodes.desc: Buffers routes until first match, replays them, then permanently rebinds this.match to the winner

nodes.label: RegExpRouter
nodes.desc: Registers paths into per-method tries, then compiles everything into one matcher

nodes.label: #buildMatcher
nodes.desc: trie.buildRegExp plus static map and wildcard coverage merge

nodes.label: TrieRouter
nodes.desc: Delegates insert/search to a recursive Node tree

nodes.label: Trie Node
nodes.desc: insert/search over method-indexed children

nodes.label: Context
nodes.desc: Holds #rawRequest, env, matchResult; finalized flips true when res is set

nodes.label: HonoRequest
nodes.desc: Lazily created view over the raw Request with bodyCache

nodes.label: param()
nodes.desc: Reads params from matchResult[0][routeIndex] and decodes them

nodes.label: get res
nodes.desc: Lazily creates a Response from prepared headers

nodes.label: set res
nodes.desc: Merges prior headers (preserving set-cookie), stores response, sets finalized = true

nodes.label: env / executionCtx
nodes.desc: Runtime bindings and ExecutionContext accessors, plus c.error slot

nodes.label: compose()
nodes.desc: koajs-style closure returning a dispatch chain over matched handlers

nodes.label: dispatch(i)
nodes.desc: Recursive step: runs middleware[i][0][0], passes () => dispatch(i+1) as next

nodes.label: req.routeIndex
nodes.desc: Written before each handler so param() knows which match entry to read

nodes.label: onError / onNotFound
nodes.desc: Catches Error into context.error and runs the app error handler; runs onNotFound when unfinalized

nodes.label: logger middleware
nodes.desc: Classic onion example: logs incoming, awaits next(), logs outgoing with status and elapsed time
